title: BEA: Blue Eagle Assistant
summary: Builds a multi-agent AI chatbot that answers student questions using Ateneo handbook references and university policies.
description: Ateneo students lack a fast, policy-aware assistant for navigating university handbooks and contacts. BEA is an AI-powered chatbot built with Streamlit that answers student questions using handbook references, university policies, and contact information. Final project for PSI AI Academy, an AI engineering course.

title: SIMS: Social Impact Mapping Simulation
summary: Simulates two-party elections where voters shift stance over time based on social influence.
description: Two-party elections involve complex social influence dynamics that simple models fail to capture. SIMS is a Java-based election simulation with a GUI, where simulated voters are placed on a social network and choose between two political parties. Each voter's stance can shift over time based on the influence of nearby voters, grounded in Social Impact Theory (Nowak, Szamrej & Latané, 1990).
